mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM product WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM purchase_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM purchase_order WHERE buyer_id=#{buyer} AND request_key=#{key}
SELECT * FROM purchase_order ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET available=available-#{quantity},reserved=reserved+#{quantity} WHERE id=#{id} AND available >= #{quantity}
UPDATE product SET reserved=reserved-#{quantity},sold=sold+#{quantity} WHERE id=#{id} AND reserved >= #{quantity}
UPDATE product SET reserved=reserved-#{quantity},available=available+#{quantity} WHERE id=#{id} AND reserved >= #{quantity}
UPDATE purchase_order SET status='PAID',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
UPDATE purchase_order SET status='CANCELLED',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM purchase_order WHERE status='PENDING' AND expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY expires_at,id LIMIT 50
SELECT action,trace_id AS traceId,thread_name AS threadName,created_at AS createdAt FROM order_history WHERE order_id=#{id} ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM outbox_event WHERE attempts < 10 AND ((status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (status='SENDING' AND lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status='SENDING',attempts=attempts+1,lease_token=#{token},lease_until=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),INTERVAL 60 SECOND) WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE outbox_event SET status='SENT',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_token=#{token} AND status='SENDING'

UPDATE outbox_event SET status=IF(attempts >= 10,'FAILED','PENDING'), next_attempt_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,LEAST(300,POW(2,attempts)),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error=#{error} WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_token=#{token} AND status='SENDING'
UPDATE outbox_event SET status='FAILED',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error='最后一次发送租约超时，需核对消费结果' WHERE status='SENDING' AND attempts >= 10 AND lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PENDING',attempts=0,next_attempt_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('FAILED','SENT')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM outbox_event ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT order_id FROM consumed_event WHERE event_id=#{eventId}
SELECT points FROM points_ledger WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO points_account(buyer_id,points) VALUES(#{buyer},#{points}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE points=points+#{points}
mapper.select: SELECT buyer_id AS buyerId,points FROM points_account ORDER BY buyer_id LIMIT 50
SELECT status,COUNT(*) AS total,MIN(created_at) AS oldestCreatedAt FROM outbox_event GROUP BY status
